RaMP multi-DB ORA identified Reactome 'Xenobiotics' (REACT:R-HSA-211981, FDR=0.00717) as the top-5 hit, driven by coumarin (chebi:28794). Mummichog network-activity analysis independently ranked 'Xenobiotics metabolism' (MUMM:xenobiotics_metabolism) as the single strongest pathway hit (p=0.00345, 2 of 2 input compounds matched within the metabolic-functional-network). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently surfaced KEGG:hsa00350 (p=0.052) with gentisic acid (2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid, chebi:17189) as the sole hit. Iron (chebi:29034) independently enriched in two Reactome iron-homeostasis pathways ('Iron uptake and transport' FDR=0.00717; 'Metal sequestration by antimicrobial proteins' FDR=0.006), consistent with secondary oxidative-stress and innate-immune co-activation. The convergent signal across ORA (set-enrichment) and m/z-network (mummichog) paradigms strengthens confidence that the treatment group exhibits altered phase-I/phase-II xenobiotic-processing capacity, with coumarin and gentisic acid as the primary driver metabolites. The benzo[a]pyrene diol epoxide (chebi:30614) and the unresolved N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl (C20319) further support exposure to aromatic xenobiotics.
